biotools.summary: Tihi Toolkit is an open-source, multiplatform software for peak detection and signal decomposition, designed to provide accessible tools for spectral data analysis. It offers a user-friendly GUI and supports various spectroscopic techniques, aiming to replace costly commercial alternatives.
